newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends a shade down vs dlr, steady vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends a shade down vs dlr, steady vs basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed a shade weaker against the dollar on Friday after range trading, dealers said.
The forint finished at 185.10/15 against the U.S. unit, slightly easier than its opening of 185.05/10 and remained pinned to the central bank's resistance level (bid) throughout trading.
The forint followed an almost static dollar/mark during Friday's session, traders added.
The NBH fixed the dollar at noon at 185.13, down from 184.70 on Thursday.
(The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide. The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
